integrity: The analytical order-statistic reduction, exact integration and rational sign bounds establish the claim; 18,000 vertex-enumeration samples, 40,000 extrema samples and quadrature only corroborate it. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact equal-edge truncations of a single regular tetrahedron in three dimensions, random line-projection widths under Haar directions, and squared coefficient of variation; no result for unequal truncations, shadow area, random central sections or higher dimensions. One plausible historical source was only accessible in abstract form; priority not definitive.
title: An interior optimum for random-width isotropy in the tetrahedron–octahedron truncation family
